Metadata.title: Emma & Éléa — Production, costs and traceability for artisan food businesses
Metadata.description: Produce just right. Sell better. One workspace for recipes, costs, production, stock, teams and traceability, built for artisan food businesses.

hero.title: Produce just right. Sell better.
hero.intro: One workspace for recipes, production, stock, teams and traceability — so bakeries, pastry shops, butcher shops and caterers can protect their margins from raw material to finished product.
hero.reassurance: Free during early access · No credit card required.
hero.audiences: Bakeries · Pastry shops · Butcher shops · Delicatessens · Caterers

problem.title: Your margins are decided before the first sale.
problem.intro: Rising ingredient costs, unsold stock and disconnected spreadsheets. Most decisions are still made on intuition.
problem.withoutIntro: Notes, files and calculations that do not talk to each other.
problem.withIntro: The recipe, the production day and the margin share the same source of truth.

pains.costs: You discover a product lost margin after the month closes.
pains.waste: Production quantities are guessed, so some days you sell out and others you throw away.
pains.traceability: Batches, expiry dates and stock counts live in notebooks.

outcomes.costs: Every recipe carries its real cost and margin, updated when purchase prices change.
outcomes.quantity: Suggested quantities based on sales history, orders, seasonality and local events.
outcomes.traceability: Stock, batches and expiry dates in one traceable record.

features.title: Everything the workshop needs, without the spreadsheet.
features.intro: Six connected areas, one source of truth — from the recipe to the margin.

costs.title: Know what each product really costs
costs.body: Ingredients, losses, packaging and labour in one cost price. Margins update when a purchase price changes.

production.title: Produce the right quantity
production.body: Suggested quantities from sales history, orders, seasonality, days of the week and local events.

stock.title: Keep stock and traceability under control
stock.body: Real-time stock, ingredient requirements, batches, expiry dates, replenishment alerts and inspection-ready records.

team.title: Put the right people on the right tasks
team.body: Skills, availability and workload in one place, with the right tasks assigned to the right people and conflicts made visible.

margins.title: See which products make money
margins.body: Compare products by profitability, volume and loss rate, and decide whether to adjust a price, a recipe or a supplier.

mobile.title: Use it in the workshop, not just the office
mobile.body: Fast on computer, tablet or mobile, with progressive integration into checkout, scales and label printers.

howItWorks.title: From one recipe to a calmer production day.
howItWorks.intro: Start with the recipe you know best. Emma & Éléa connects the rest as you go.

recipes.title: Add your recipes
recipes.body: Enter ingredients, quantities and purchase prices. The cost price includes losses, packaging and labour.

production.title: Set your production
production.body: Use sales history, orders and seasonality to decide what to make. Ingredient requirements and tasks follow.

margin.title: Run the day and check the margin
margin.body: Track batches, stock, expiry and waste. See what sold, what did not, and what to adjust next time.

pricing.title: Start in early access. No credit card required.
pricing.intro: Emma & Éléa is in active development. Early-access businesses get free access and a direct say in what ships next.

assurances.cancel: Stop using the workspace at any time

faq.title: What businesses ask before starting.
faq.intro: A few clear answers about access, setup and your data.

card.question: Do I need a credit card to start?
card.answer: No. Early access is free and no payment details are required.

setup.question: How long does setup take?
setup.answer: Start with one recipe. Add your ingredients, quantities and purchase prices, and Emma & Éléa calculates the first cost price. You can add the rest at your own pace.

tools.question: Does Emma & Éléa replace my POS or accounting software?
tools.answer: No. It sits alongside them and focuses on recipes, production, costs, stock and traceability. Integration with checkout, scales and label printers is progressive.

mobile.question: Can I use it on a tablet or phone in the workshop?
mobile.answer: Yes. The workspace is designed for computer, tablet and mobile, so production, waste and stock counts can be recorded where the work happens.

data.question: Who owns my data?
data.answer: Your recipes, costs and production records belong to your business. Access is role-based, and we do not sell your data. Hosting and security details will be published before paid plans start.

cancel.question: Can I stop using it or export my data?
cancel.answer: You can stop using the workspace at any time during early access. Before paid plans start, we will publish clear cancellation and export terms.

finalCta.title: Ready to produce just right?
finalCta.intro: Start with your recipes and cost prices. The rest follows: production, stock, teams and traceability, in one place.
finalCta.reassurance: Free during early access · No credit card required.

footer.tagline: Produce just right, sell better and protect your margins.
